info.title: QuarantinePay
info.summary: The trust layer that lets AI agents safely spend money.
info.description: Agent-negotiated, buyer-approved purchase contracts with delivery-gated settlement. AI output is advisory and has no payment authority: deterministic policy validates contracts, the buyer approves the exact contract digest, an Ed25519-signed intent binds it, and capture requires buyer review. Sellers, goods and deliveries are fictional. Replay mode simulates payments; only provider-confirmed PayPal Sandbox results count as confirmed. Production PayPal endpoints are never used. A hold is not escrow. Endpoints under /api/agent and /api/analytics describe the agent-commerce upgrade; their live Sandbox behaviour is pending verification.

post.summary: Start an agent purchasing task from a natural-language request
post.description: Planning and negotiation run in the background; poll GET /api/agent/tasks/{id}. Nothing is purchased until the buyer approves the exact proposal digest. Control characters are stripped and the request is truncated to 2000 characters.

value.request: Find me a market research report on AI note-taking apps under $100 covering three competitors, including 5 credible sources.

400.description: Request shorter than 8 characters after trimming, or unknown fields

403.description: Origin rejected (cookie session without matching Origin)

200.description: Up to 20 recent tasks for the current payment mode

post.summary: Approve the exact proposed contract and create the order
post.description: The digest must equal the task's current proposal_digest. The contract is re-validated, signed into an Ed25519 intent (expires 30 minutes after approval; sku agent-contract-v1, policy_digest = contract digest) and consumed once to create the order. In sandbox mode the worker then creates a PayPal Orders v2 AUTHORIZE order; the buyer approves at PayPal and calls POST /api/orders/{id}/authorize.

post.description: An authorized order accepts one JSON artifact up to 64 KiB before its deadline; it moves to quarantined and is checked asynchronously. Contract orders take {file, content} Markdown and are checked for required nonempty sections, distinct competitor count, distinct valid HTTPS source count, .md name and size; instruction-like text forces a policy hold. Catalog scenario orders take the scenario-specific shapes shown. Deliveries are never executed.

post.summary: Approve or reject a delivery awaiting buyer review
post.description: Requires buyer_review state and an unexpired deadline and intent. Approval queues capture; rejection queues void. Approving a delivery under policy hold requires acknowledge_risk=true and is audited as risk_override. Provider settlement remains asynchronous.

409.description: Order is not awaiting timely review, or 'policy hold': approving a flagged delivery without acknowledge_risk

sessionCookie.name: qp_session
sessionCookie.description: Browser session from POST /login. Mutations additionally require an Origin header equal to QP_PUBLIC_BASE.

amount_minor.description: USD 1.00 for catalog intents; the contract amount for agent-contract-v1.

policy_digest.description: Scenario/invoice policy digest, or the PurchaseContract digest for agent-contract-v1.

scenario.description: Signed acceptance terms for scenario orders; absent on legacy invoice intents.

contract.description: Buyer-approved contract; present only on agent-contract-v1 intents and mutually exclusive with scenario.

PurchaseContract.description: Canonical agent-negotiated contract. Validated by deterministic policy (crates/core/src/contract.rs); its digest is SHA-256 of its canonical JSON serialization.

amount_minor.description: Agreed price; >= seller floor and <= budget_minor.

budget_minor.description: Buyer budget after policy clamping (global agent ceiling USD 100.00).

required_sections.description: Must include Competitor analysis and Sources.

negotiation_digest.description: SHA-256 of the negotiation transcript the buyer saw.

Objective.description: Buyer objective after policy clamping. An explicit dollar amount in the request is a hard ceiling the planner cannot raise.

Negotiation.description: Deterministic, budget-bounded negotiation with three fictional seller agents.

source.description: rules = model unavailable or output rejected; the deterministic parser was used.

proposal.description: Contract awaiting buyer approval; null when no deal.

proposal_digest.description: SHA-256 of the proposal; must be echoed back to approve.

request.description: Plain-English purchase request. Control characters are stripped; text beyond 2000 characters is truncated; at least 8 non-blank characters are required.

outcome.description: Replay mode only: simulated authorization decline or ambiguous capture. Rejected in sandbox mode.

ContractDelivery.description: Delivery for a contract order. Treated strictly as data; never executed. Whole JSON body limited to 64 KiB.

content.description: Markdown; sections are '# Heading' lines; competitors and sources are list items.

acknowledge_risk.description: Required to approve a delivery under policy hold; recorded as risk_override in the audit log.

rule.description: e.g. override_instructions, role_hijack, verdict_tampering, payment_command, model_flagged_manipulation (model findings must quote the delivery verbatim)

Analysis.description: Advisory delivery analysis. It can only add caution; it never relaxes a deterministic failure or a policy hold.

relevance.description: Model relevance judgement, or not_assessed when the model is unavailable.

recommended_action.description: Always reject when injection is detected; escalate when the model is unavailable.

Order.description: Durable order state. Known states: create_pending, approval_pending, authorize_pending, authorized, quarantined, buyer_review, capture_pending, captured, void_pending, voided, declined, reconciliation_required. A policy hold is reported in analysis.policy_hold.

request_id.description: Stable PayPal-Request-Id for the pending operation.

provider_confirmed.description: Sandbox order in a state reached only via a PayPal response; always false in replay.
